customManagers.description: The smartctl exporter image is set through HelmRelease values, which neither the flux nor the kubernetes manager reads.
AdGuard Home's image tag is set in HelmRelease values without a repository (the chart supplies it).

packageRules.description: Standard policy for everything Renovate manages: minor, patch, digest and pin updates are pushed straight to main (branch automerge). prCreation waits for the checks so a PR only appears when they fail. Needs the Renovate GitHub App to be allowed to push to main. Rules further down can hold an update back.
A major version is never merged unattended: it opens a PR labelled major.
Home Assistant releases monthly 'minor' versions that behave like majors (breaking integration changes), and hass-config is checked against this version in CI. Every update, even a patch, is a PR.
AdGuard Home migrates its config schema on start and old binaries cannot read the newer file (see the comment in helm-release.yaml), and it is the cluster's DNS. Every update is a PR.

Flux itself. A new version regenerates clusters/k3s/flux-system/gotk-components.yaml with `flux install --export` and the Components header, so the extra image controllers stay. Always a PR: run `flux migrate` and read the release notes first.

linuxserver/lidarr also publishes the legacy 0.8.1.2135 build as the tag 8.1.2135, which Renovate reads as a major upgrade. The real releases are 2.x and 3.x (3.1.6 is latest); the 0.8 code cannot read their database.
binhex tags look like 2.2.0-9-01-libtorrentv1 (version, build, rebuild, variant). Stay on the libtorrentv1 variant.
Registries and datasources without usable release timestamps are exempt from the cooldown, as are update types that have no release age.
git, kubernetes-api and lock-file updates carry no release timestamp.

kubectl client skew: stay within one minor of the cluster (k3s 1.36). Patch updates flow; a new minor is listed on the Dependency Dashboard and needs approval, which you give after k3s is upgraded in nix-config.
Keep Flux HelmRelease chart versions free of digests.
Traefik chart majors rename values (v42 needed ports.*.http.*, log/accessLog). Listed on the Dependency Dashboard; approve there only after migrating the values and render-testing.
